reason: I already pay my agency a retainer that covers influencer posts, so I don't want to find and manage creators myself and pay them over UPI on top of that. Free during the pilot is nice, but my real cost is the time, and I'm not convinced these creators are better than the ones my agency picks.
objection: Most of these creators have fake or bought followers, and 'Self-reported' numbers tell me nothing. Also, will my staff actually remember to tap +1 every time someone uses a code during a busy lunch rush?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing another Bengaluru café near me that got a clear number of real walk-ins from a Verified creator through Mitra, with the cost per customer, so I could compare it against what my agency gets me.
